6a8f4d5e90206485fa1d2d5a description: Ah, there you are, warrior. Got something that might interest you. Word is a plane came down somewhere in the Priozersk nature reserve. Nobody seems to know what happened—or nobody wants to say. Either way, a wreck like that doesn't just fall out of the sky without leaving something worth finding. Head to Woods, track it down, and have a look around. Bring me anything interesting you find. Well? You in?
6a8f4d5e90206485fa1d2d5a startedMessageT: Track down the fallen plane in the Priozersk nature reserve and look over the wreck.
6a8f4d5e90206485fa1d2d5a successMessageT: Ah, you ran into it, huh? It's been there a while, but nobody really knows much! You and I, rookie, we're alike in one thing: I decided to figure this out too. We can help each other.
6a8f4d5e90206485fa1d2d5a failMessageText: No wreck, no story. Go back to Woods and find the plane.
6a8f4d5e90206485fa1d2d5b description: Prove yourself to me! Once you've earned my second loyalty level, come ask me again about the fallen plane. Then we'll help each other.
6a8f4d5e90206485fa1d2d5b startedMessageT: Reach Loyalty Level 2 with Prapor, then report back about the fallen plane.
6a8f4d5e90206485fa1d2d5b successMessageT: Good. Now we can talk about the plane properly. I found out that the first ones to leave the city were big shots from TerraGroup. One or two people leaving could be a coincidence, but this was a massive crowd all at once—like those bastards knew everything beforehand.
6a8f4d5e90206485fa1d2d5b failMessageText: Trust is earned, not requested. Come back when your standing proves it.
6a8f4d5e90206485fa1d2d5c description: The TerraGroup people always rode around in black G-Wagons, and that's how they were trying to leave the city. I've got a tip that one of them was carrying a very important thumb drive. Rumor has it the drive has information about that plane—something very important. I smell one hell of a secret here! Where there are secrets, there's big money. The big shot with the flash drive got taken out. I don't know if the Scavs shot him, the military intercepted him, or it was someone else. In any case, it looks like the guy left the flash drive in his car.
6a8f4d5e90206485fa1d2d5c startedMessageT: Search the G-Wagon by Shoreline's collapsed tunnel and bring me its flash drive.
6a8f4d5e90206485fa1d2d5c successMessageT: Perfection! I was right to think it had something important on it.
6a8f4d5e90206485fa1d2d5c failMessageText: The drive is still beside that G-Wagon. Bring it back before somebody else finds it.
6a8f4d5e90206485fa1d2d68: Find the G-Wagon flash drive in raid
6a8f4d5e90206485fa1d2d5d description: There were three big shots on board: TerraGroup's vice president and two Security Council members. I asked around—there was no proper rescue operation. Those people weren't just anyone; they were high-ranking, important passengers. Now it makes sense. The flash drive confirms the plane was shot down! The information alone is worth a lot, but if we can also find out who ordered the hit, it will be worth even more. So I'm planning to get the black box. I've already set everything up. When you find the flight recorder, leave it for Elektronik at Fisherman's Island on the coast. There's a corner room in the old house. Elektronik will grab it from there himself.
6a8f4d5e90206485fa1d2d5d startedMessageT: Recover the flight recorder on Woods, then conceal it in the ruined room on Fisherman's Island.
6a8f4d5e90206485fa1d2d5d successMessageT: Yeah, but it's not all good news. Elektronik says his supplies are cut off, and he's got no tools to deal with the flight recorder.
6a8f4d5e90206485fa1d2d5d failMessageText: Recover the recorder and hide it where I told you. My men aren't searching two maps for your mistakes.
6a8f4d5e90206485fa1d2d6c: Find the crashed plane's flight recorder in raid
6a8f4d5e90206485fa1d2d6d: Leave the flight recorder in the specified spot
6a8f4d5e90206485fa1d2d5e description: Stop crying, I'm not asking for free! Elektronik says his supplies are cut off, and he's got no tools to deal with the flight recorder. I'd lend him mine, but everything is already reserved. You'll have to look for some electronic parts in the wild. I'll send you a full list with my guys. Once you get everything, pass it to me, and I'll forward it to Elektronik through Mechanic. No more drop-offs on the coast this time. You'll need to wait a bit after this; I'll contact you when it's ready.
6a8f4d5e90206485fa1d2d5e startedMessageT: Bring me three rechargeable batteries, five printed circuit boards, and two toolsets, all found in raid.
6a8f4d5e90206485fa1d2d5e successMessageT: All here? Good job. Perfection! I'll sort it out and get everything to Elektronik.
6a8f4d5e90206485fa1d2d5e failMessageText: Elektronik needs every part on that list, found in raid. Bring me the complete set.
6a8f4d5e90206485fa1d2d6f: Hand over 3 Rechargeable batteries found in raid
6a8f4d5e90206485fa1d2d70: Hand over 5 Printed circuit boards found in raid
6a8f4d5e90206485fa1d2d71: Hand over 2 Toolsets found in raid
6a8f4d5e90206485fa1d2d5f description: Now we've got news: good and bad. The box burned. Relax—Elektronik got a transcript of the conversations, but this bastard isn't giving it up for free. Seems like the intel is very, very serious. He's asking for a real fortune, but you know what? I'll pay him. We've made a deal after all. I need you to pick up his secure flash drive from the drop point. It's at Shoreline again, in some moldy old house. Bring it here. I'll be waiting.
6a8f4d5e90206485fa1d2d5f startedMessageT: Find Elektronik's secure flash drive in the chairman's house and hand it over to me.
6a8f4d5e90206485fa1d2d5f successMessageT: There you are, soldier! Finally some good news. Hand it over. What in the goddamn... What kind of shit went down there?! And who the hell is this Mister Kerman...? Hang on a second, someone's calling. Alright, this is urgent. You go for now; I'll be in touch later, friend. My guys will give you the reward.
6a8f4d5e90206485fa1d2d5f failMessageText: The chairman's house, abandoned village, Shoreline. I need Elektronik's drive, not excuses.
6a8f4d5e90206485fa1d2d73: Find Elektronik's secure flash drive in raid
6a8f4d5e90206485fa1d2d60 description: Elektronik's transcript mentioned some Mister Kerman, and now he called me himself. Used a voice scrambler, ha. He said there was an armored case on that plane. When the plane started coming apart, it fell out. Kerman claimed it contained a ticket out of Tarkov. Yeah, he actually called it that—the 'Ticket.' Find that case. By my calculations, it should have landed somewhere around Woods. Oh, and one more thing: I sold the information about the downed plane. You helped me a lot, so here's your cut from a pretty big website. Now go find me that case.
6a8f4d5e90206485fa1d2d60 startedMessageT: Recover the armored case from the plane's cockpit and deliver it directly to me.
6a8f4d5e90206485fa1d2d60 successMessageT: Alrighty, let's take a look. Give it here, and you're dismissed. A deal's a deal—my guys will give you the one and a half million.
6a8f4d5e90206485fa1d2d60 failMessageText: The case is in that cockpit, and it comes directly to me. Don't make me repeat myself.
6a8f4d5e90206485fa1d2d77: Find the armored case in raid
